findings.label: Presence: local user connection state during disconnect
findings.description: When the local user disconnects, they remain in the participants list but with connectionState='disconnected'. This causes a moment where you see yourself as 'Disconnected' in the room list during a temporary network blip. Update the presence effect to remove the local participant (or mark isYou=false) when socket.disconnect fires, to avoid this false signal.

findings.label: Mobile responsive chat/presence drawer not implemented
findings.description: RoomChat and RoomPresence components are marked for mobile responsiveness in comments but drawer/modal toggling is not hooked up. The layout currently has these panels side-by-side. Confirm mobile breakpoint layout and implement drawer or bottom-sheet toggle for chat on mobile.

findings.label: Token refresh during socket session
findings.description: Socket.IO auth is established at connection time but token may expire during a long session. If token expires and server rejects the reconnect, the socket will not auto-refresh the token. Implement token refresh hook or use token from getAuthToken() dynamically in socket reconnect handler.
